cloudRunEvidence.extraction: Embedded regional pricing table immediately after the Warsaw (europe-central2) record: active CPU 0.0000336 USD/vCPU-second, idle min-instance CPU 0.0000035 USD/vCPU-second, active/idle RAM 0.0000035 USD/GiB-second, requests 0.40 USD/million.

cloudRunCpuBoostEvidence.extraction: Official CPU table specifies a 2-vCPU boost for a service configured from 0 through 1 vCPU. The feature covers startup and 10 seconds after container startup; the scenario assumes 3 seconds startup plus 10 seconds post-start and prices the incremental 1 vCPU at active CPU rate.

cloudStorageEvidence.extraction: Regional Standard table lists Warsaw (europe-central2) and $0.000027397/GiB-hour. Single-region flat-namespace Standard operations: Class A $0.005/1000, Class B $0.0004/1000. General internet egress: $0.12/GiB through 10 TiB, $0.11 through 150 TiB, then $0.08. Always Free applies only to us-west1, us-central1, and us-east1, so no storage/request/egress free amount is modeled for Warsaw.

firestoreEvidence.extraction: Embedded regional Default USD table immediately after Warsaw (europe-central2): Document Reads $0.039, Writes $0.117, Deletes $0.013 per 100,000; Stored Data and PITR data $0.000267123/GiB-hour (approximately $0.195/GiB-month at 730 hours). The first default table values are Iowa and were rejected. Empty query minimum and index-entry rules documented separately.

networkEvidence.extraction: Warsaw (europe-central2) Premium-tier outbound Europe list rates: $0.12/GiB through 1 TiB, $0.11 through 10 TiB, then $0.085. Cloud Run states its 1 GiB/month free internet egress applies within North America only; Warsaw-to-Europe is modeled without it.

freeTierMonthly.scope: Shared across projects on a billing account; this calculator defaults to gross cost and does not consume shared quota.

cloudRun.billingNotes: Request-based active time includes start, graceful shutdown and time processing requests; minimum instances have a separate idle rate. Prices in the published table are regional; Cloud Run's public page embeds per-region tables and lists europe-central2 as Tier 2.

firestore.notes: Warsaw (europe-central2), regional Default USD prices (not Iowa default): reads $0.039/100k, writes $0.117/100k, deletes $0.013/100k, storage $0.000267123/GiB-hour. SDK document snapshots are not automatically billed reads. `firestoreReadsBillableEstimate` must be supplied with its conversion basis; query minimum (1 read/query, including empty queries), index-entry reads, rules-dependent reads and request type can change billing.

cloudStorage.notes: Warsaw Standard storage regional rate and single-region flat namespace operations. Cloud Storage internet egress uses its separate Worldwide Destinations table: $0.12/GiB up to 10 TiB, $0.11/GiB to 150 TiB, $0.08/GiB thereafter. No free egress tier applied. Bucket class, HNS, destination mix and retrieval charges must be changed if deployment differs.

identityPlatform.sms: excluded unless country-specific SMS count and price are supplied
identityPlatform.notes: Firebase Authentication tier-1 providers include email, phone, anonymous and social; SMS is billed separately. MAU count is a unique monthly user count, not DAU multiplied by sessions. Anonymous MAU treatment depends on automatic clean-up.

artifactRegistry.notes: Official shared billing-account monthly free tier is 0.5 GiB, but it is not applied; model prices gross storage because account-wide usage is unknown. Internet image pulls from Artifact Registry are not included here; account for them via network egress if relevant.

secretManager.notes: Shared billing-account free tier; model defaults to gross cost.

rates.currencyAndTaxes: USD only. No exchange conversion, VAT, tax, negotiated discount, committed-use discount, or account-specific credit is assumed.
